raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 re-delivered 333 transactions (ingest 2026-01-19 05:00) with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds, e.g. 1768716039000, which equals 2026-01-18 06:00:39 UTC and matches the original ISO copy. The cast fails on those values, and the duplicate copies would also double-count gold sums if they were parsed. The fix is to parse epoch-ms timestamps, then keep one row per txn_id, which is safe because the copies are identical apart from txn_ts format and ingest_ts.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, txn_ts_parsed AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(txn_ts, '[0-9]+') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts_parsed FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) = 1;"}}
